title: Luxury Chic Modern Home Minutes from the Gulch
description:
Wade Ave is ready for you! This house was beautifully designed by our professional interior designer giving you luxurious vibes all around. Make yourself at home in our spacious 2,900 sq ft home featuring 5 bedrooms, 4 full/2 half baths that sleeps up to 12 people! Our gourmet kitchen is well-equipped with everything you need to make an amazing homemade meal. Wade Ave is just minutes away from the Gulch and 2 miles from Broadway! Just a short Uber ride downtown!

The space
The spacious house includes 2 kitchens, 2 living areas, an amazing outdoor patio, & a rooftop deck overlooking the street. With 2,900 sq ft, our space sleeps up to 12 people comfortably on our amazing Zinus mattresses and 600 thread count sheets. The kitchen is fully equipped for cooking, dining, and entertaining. Brand new stainless steel appliances all throughout.

Guest access
3 free parking spots are available in front of house! You will be provided with a code to get into the house for easy access. No fuss with keys!

Other things to note
Please be courteous and take care of our home.

*** PLEASE NOTE:
SMOKING INSIDE HOME $400 FINE
PARTIES NOT PERMITTED: $200 FINE
